name: Preparation for SEM/FIB Imaging
description: Preparation of IC samples for scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and focused ion beam (FIB) passive imaging. Covers SEM stub mounting, conductive coating/sputtering for non-conductive samples, charge mitigation techniques, surface cleaning for electron imaging (plasma cleaning, UV-ozone), correct sample orientation and height adjustment for column geometry, and backscatter vs. secondary electron imaging preparation. Also covers FIB cross-section site preparation and TEM lamella lift-out preparation. Goal: clean, conductive, correctly mounted samples for high-resolution electron imaging.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to SEM/FIB sample preparation

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands SEM sample requirements and basic preparation steps
evidence: Can explain why SEM requires conductive samples and vacuum compatibility
Understands the difference between SE and BSE imaging and their preparation implications
Aware of common SEM preparation artifacts (charging, contamination, curtaining)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Mounts and coats standard samples for SEM under supervision
evidence: Mounts samples on SEM stubs with conductive adhesive (silver paste, carbon tape) with correct orientation
Operates sputter coater to deposit thin conductive layer (Au, Pt, C) on non-conductive samples
Performs plasma cleaning to remove hydrocarbon contamination before loading
Produces basic SEM images of prepared samples

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently prepares samples for SEM/FIB across imaging modes and applications
evidence: Selects appropriate coating material and thickness for imaging mode (SE vs BSE vs EBSD)
Prepares plan-view and cross-section samples for SEM with correct exposure of target features
Identifies and mitigates preparation-induced artifacts (redeposition, amorphization, curtaining)
Prepares site-specific FIB cross-section targets with fiducial markers for navigation

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles advanced preparation for specialized SEM/FIB applications
evidence: Prepares TEM lamella via FIB lift-out with controlled thickness and minimal damage
Develops preparation workflows for in-situ SEM/FIB experiments (heating, electrical biasing)
Optimizes preparation for advanced SEM techniques (EBIC, EBSD, voltage contrast)
Mentors team on artifact prevention and application-specific preparation optimization

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines SEM/FIB preparation methodology and specifies equipment for the lab
evidence: Defines lab SOPs for SEM/FIB sample preparation across all imaging applications
Specifies sputter coating, plasma cleaning, and sample handling infrastructure
Develops preparation techniques for novel sample types (flexible electronics, MEMS, photonic ICs)
Trains teams and conducts proficiency assessments for SEM/FIB preparation

assessment_methods.description: Prepare and mount samples for SEM imaging in both plan-view and cross-section, demonstrating correct coating, mounting, and artifact-free results
Observe sputter coating operation, plasma cleaning procedure, and sample loading into SEM chamber

equipment: Sputter coater (Au/Pt/C targets) for conductive coating
SEM stub mounting station with conductive adhesives
Ion mill / ion polisher for high-quality cross-section preparation (e.g., Leica EM TIC 3X)
